proposals.title: Tilted 3D reel cards push in, hard cut to a glowing ring stat counting up
proposals.why: DJ4 whole (2.8 s): two reel cards with view counts tilted in 3D drift toward a 50 mm camera and spread apart; at 1 s a hard cut to a blue progress ring (61.9% to 89.6%) with a 12 fps count to 169K and a '100% Non-followers' legend, the cards echoed as a pixelated mosaic, blue haze and faint scanlines over everything.
proposals.call: tiltedStatsReveal(comp, {at, cards: ["5.6M", "3.2M"], cutAt: 1, progress: [0.6194, 0.896], countMax: 190, suffix: "K", pct: "100%", label: "Non-followers", color: "#0a8aeb", ring: ["#2dbcff", "#4fd0ff"], titles: ["Normal Reel", "Trial Reel"], tilt: [-21.97, 16.91, 8.69]})
proposals.overlaps: uses ringStat, countUp, accentGlow, lightSweep, reelCard, tiltedCardPush, mosaicEcho, settleSlide, driftApart, statLegend, hazeGlow, scanlineTexture

proposals.title: Precomp tilted in 3D, pushed slowly toward a 50 mm camera
proposals.why: Tilted Cards is a 3D precomp layer at X -21.97, Y 16.91, Z 8.69 degrees, z 296.5 to 232 in 1 s linear (~65 px/s) with Deep Glow 116 / 0.0174: flat UI that feels like a physical object floating at an angle.
proposals.overlaps: cameraDrift (proposals.json) moves a camera/null rig; this tilts and pushes the layer itself

proposals.title: Reel placeholder card: outline, play button, eye + view count
proposals.why: 553.7x984.4 r26 card, fill #1a1a21, 4 px #dbdee6 outline, play button (ring at 35%, triangle at 45% white), eye icon + '5.6M' (SF Pro Medium 62, #ebebed, tracking 20) at the bottom left.
proposals.call: reelCard(comp, {views: "5.6M", x, y, width: 553.7, play: true, footage?})
proposals.overlaps: same id as reelCard in dj5-card-variants.proposals.json (this adds the eye + view count); postCard (DJ1) is the same family with Post/Trash buttons

proposals.title: One card eases away from its neighbour, still drifting at the cut
proposals.why: Card L moves -66.8 px in 1 s (out 100 px/s at 10%, in 30 px/s at 70%) while Card R holds: the pair opens up without ever landing.
proposals.overlaps: slideUp enters and lands; this never lands. Sibling of settleSlide

proposals.title: Progress ring (base + fill) with a counter in the middle
proposals.why: Ring Base (201 px, #1a1f25, 33 px) + Ring Fill (#2dbcff to #4fd0ff gradient stroke, trim end = CTRL Progress x 100, scale -100% so it fills counter-clockwise, Deep Glow 150, light-sweep pass at the end); count above, legend beside.
proposals.call: ringStat(comp, {from: 0.6194, to: 0.896, at, duration: 1.8, size: 201, width: 33, colors: ["#2dbcff", "#4fd0ff"], mirror: true})
proposals.overlaps: same id as proposals.json ringStat; uses countUp

proposals.title: Number that counts up from a CTRL slider
proposals.why: Count = floor(Progress x 190) + "K", sampled in 1/12 s steps 0.1 s ahead, so it ticks 118K to 169K at 12 fps like a real counter.
proposals.call: countUp(textLayer, {from: 0.6194, to: 0.896, multiply: 190, at, duration: 1.8, suffix: "K", steps: 12})
proposals.overlaps: same id as proposals.json countUp (adds multiply + steps options)

proposals.title: Big percentage over a coloured dot + grey label
proposals.why: '100%' (SF Pro Medium 58, #ebebed, tracking 50) above a 12 px #0a8aeb dot and 'Non-followers' (Medium 36, #787d85, tracking 25): the chart-legend read-out beside the ring.

proposals.title: Previous scene's cards echoed flat and pixelated behind the new stat
proposals.why: After the hard cut, flat copies of the reel cards and their titles sit under a Mosaic adjustment (56 x 31 blocks): continuity across the cut without competing with the ring.

proposals.title: Block slides sideways and never quite stops
proposals.why: The Stats layer moves -90 px over 1.8 s (out 65 px/s at 50%, in 15 px/s at 5%): a held stat that keeps living until the cut.
proposals.overlaps: slideUp (vertical, lands); driftApart is the same idea on a single card

proposals.title: Light sweep across an accent
proposals.why: CC Light Sweep on the ring fill (direction 30, sweep 60, edge 40) passing once: center (960, 540) to (990, 560), width 44 to 70 over 2.43 to 2.8 s, starting from rest (60% influence).
proposals.call: lightSweep(layer, {mode: "pass", at: 2.4333, duration: 0.3667, angle: 30, width: [44, 70], sweep: 60, edge: 40})
proposals.overlaps: same id as proposals.json lightSweep (DJ3 is the wiggling shimmer variant)

proposals.title: Deep Glow on accent shapes and numbers
proposals.why: Deep Glow radius 150 / exposure 0.02 on the ring fill, and 116 / 0.0174 on the tilted cards precomp.

proposals.title: Tinted radial haze that travels with the content
proposals.why: An Add-mode solid with a radial ramp #0f1b23 to black (radius 850, 125% wide), parented to the Stats block, so a cool light sits behind the stat and moves with it.
proposals.overlaps: background / darkStage are the backdrop; this is a light added on top of it

proposals.title: Faint horizontal scanlines over the whole frame
proposals.why: An adjustment layer with Venetian Blinds (completion 42.63%, direction 90, width 32.97, feather 91.4) at 14.85% opacity adds a subtle screen texture.
